data.narrative:
AstroForge is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company founded by Matt Gialich and Jose Acain, having raised approximately $56M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space, positioned across seed through Series B stages.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for post-money value, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding $112M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B Series B), and Starcloud ($1.1B seed)—produces a median of $1.3B with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring using the sector's 25.3x P/S multiple cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures.

Triangulation of applicable methods supports a valuation range of $95M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $706M. The substantial spread reflects tension between earlier-stage fundamentals ($56M raised, 2.0x step-up) and peer comps skewed toward later-stage capital raises. Key uncertainty centers on AstroForge's operational progress relative to its peer cohort and whether recent capital deployment has materially de-risked the venture.
